roles.primary: main brand colour: one hero shape, buttons, highlighted words
roles.accent: secondary shape or a soft highlight; never body text
roles.surface: cards and panels on the background
roles.onPrimary: text on top of a primary-coloured shape

pairs.use: highlighted words and the hero shape

type.scale: headline 45 characters or fewer; body 40 px or more at 1080p; captions 40 px

logo.clearSpace: half the logo height on every side
logo.onBackgrounds: dark plate or a white plate; never on a busy photo
logo.notes: Original files only. Do not redraw the owner's logo by hand.

avatar.motif: one object, one main colour, no text inside
avatar.smallSizeRule: at 64 px and below, drop fine detail and keep the one bright element

motion.easing: springs for entrances, ease-in-out for moves; nothing bounces twice
motion.pacing: at least 3 seconds per idea in a short piece; time scenes to the narration
motion.captions: the exact written text, 44 characters per line or fewer, at the bottom; credits and lower thirds sit above them
motion.music: built-in procedural bed, ducked under the voice, about -14 LUFS and -1.5 dBTP

dos: Keep one hero element per frame.
Look at every deliverable at full size and at its smallest size.
donts: No paid font or stock asset without the owner's yes.
